title: HtmlInputReset
responsibility: Renders the native input control with type reset without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlInputReset.children
inputs.description: Optional Svelte Snippet that the component destructures out of its props, so it is never spread onto the input as an attribute. The template never references it, so passing a snippet has no effect on the rendered input.

outputs.name: HtmlInputReset
outputs.description: The rendered native input element: every prop other than children is spread onto it, then type is set to reset after the spread, so any passed type is overridden. No wrapper element surrounds it, and no child content is rendered.
